title: 90-day growth strategy for a small business

gates.text: Truth: no claim, number, customer, quote or result that isn't in confirmed facts or cited research; every number is sourced, from the owner's data, or labelled 'assumption' with a validation date.
Budget fit: planned spend and owner hours add up to no more than what was stated.
Prioritisation: a ranked plan with no more than 3 active acquisition channels (1 primary, 1 secondary, at most 1 hygiene item) for a business under ~$50k/month revenue.
Safe and compliant: no fake or incentivised reviews, review gating, bought followers, scraping in breach of terms, misleading claims, or advice that ignores regulated-industry rules.

anchors.5: Names the single biggest constraint (message unclear, no demand capture, conversion leak, CAC above margin, retention leak, capacity) with evidence, after auditing what already works.

anchors.3: Mentions CAC or LTV without computing them.
anchors.5: Computes affordable CAC from price and margin with maths shown, checks each channel against it, and recommends a price or offer change if nothing fits.
1 primary + 1 secondary chosen by modified ICE with CAC-fit and time-to-signal gates; explicit not-doing list with a reason per channel.

anchors.3: Some tailoring to the business type.
anchors.5: Channel mix matches business type, price point, buying behaviour, geography and the owner's skills.
Each action names asset, channel, audience, cadence, owner, hours and spend; week-1 checklist of 5 items or fewer.
North Star in the owner's terms plus 3–5 leading indicators with weekly targets from a stated baseline; tracking setup specified (UTMs, server-side conversions, 'how did you hear', weekly scorecard).

anchors.1: No tests, or A/B tests impossible at this traffic.
anchors.5: Pre-registered tests sized to real volume with run time and kill/scale thresholds; a day-45 decision point.
Channels, offers and creative explicitly carry the chosen position and VoC language.

anchors.1: Pre-2024 playbook (blog-first SEO, interest targeting, company-page posting).
anchors.5: Adjusts channels for AI search, Meta and Google automation, founder-led LinkedIn and measurement loss, with sourced figures stated as ranges.

anchors.3: Risks listed without mitigations or dates.
anchors.5: Foundation, test and commit phases with dependencies; risks and assumptions each with a mitigation and a validation date.
